<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum lacks any downfield peaks in the typical carbonyl region (≈190–220 ppm). The most downfield carbon signal is at 160.80 ppm, which is consistent with an aromatic carbon rather than a carbonyl carbon. The IR spectrum also shows no strong C=O stretching band around 1700 cm⁻¹; only aromatic C=C bands (~1600 cm⁻¹) are present. Therefore, the molecule contains no carbonyl (C=O) groups.</thought>
